description: setup.commander_death, the SKIRMISH screen's commander toggle: seat 1's commander at 5 % health, holding position and fire, is attacked by a light laser tower of seat 0 150 world units away, and three CORAKs of seat 1, holding position and fire, stand more than 700 world units from it and from each other. With commander_death true (ActiveCommanderDeath 1) the commander's death kills the rest of its side: the three CORAKs die within a tick of it, read tick-exactly from the level's recording by tools/replay/killall_check.py REC --owner 1 --count 3. Loaded with --commander-death 0 (ActiveCommanderDeath 0) they live on. The load's steps say what the level runs with, read back from main+0x37EF6.
